content.text:
Only Er2MgTiO6 (mp-1212787) is present. I simulated three candidates (mp-1212787, mvc-9392 and mp-1279763) and compared each with the observed pattern.

- **Er2MgTiO6 match:** its simulated pattern lines up with the observed one throughout.
  - The strongest peak is at about 23.2° (observed about 23.25°).
  - There is a broad peak at about 28.6° and a peak at 32.6°.
  - The strong doublet at 33.3° and 34.0° matches, as do the pair at about 35.5° and 36°.
  - The weaker features near 38.3°, 39.6°, 41–43° and 47–48° are also reproduced.
- **Ruled out:** neither of the other two simulated candidates matches. PrMg(MoO3)2 (mvc-9392) puts its main peak near 31° and Na4FeO5 (mp-1279763) puts strong peaks near 16.5° and 37–38°. The observed pattern has nothing at any of those positions.
- **No second phase:** Er2MgTiO6 accounts for all the observed peaks, so I don't think a second phase is present. I did not simulate the other six candidates.
